summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing a routine PDMR share transaction. Maya Martinez-Davis, President US, acquired 9.221 notional American Depositary Shares at $51.78 each within her Executive Supplemental Savings Plan account on August 24, 2026. This is a routine internal plan acquisition, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic implications are present. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer notification of director/PDMR dealings.
